resolved_conflicts.explanation: Fire Lookout says one mile southeast of Okanogan. The 1956 survey description says about 1.0 mile south of Okanogan and 4.0 miles southwest of Omak. The story reports both and does not reconcile them.
The Register says removed in 1963, Fire Lookout says destroyed, and WillhiteWeb says removed or destroyed. The story reports the disagreement.
The Register photo caption mentions the foundation of a tower at Jackass Butte, but no other source describes a tower there. The story reports the caption only.

notes_for_editor: No access or current-condition source beyond the Register foundation photo caption, so no access key and no visit key. height_m 4.1 is converted from the 13.6 ft roof peak above ground in the 1956 survey; it is not a tower height. The location conflict is unresolved. A 1944 photo caption on WillhiteWeb describes a plan to keep the station for the Forest Service after the war, but no source says it was carried out, so the story leaves it out. No named Forest Service lookouts were found for this site.
